description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans project components related to grain providers and extensions using the Xunit testing framework. It tests functionalities such as extension installation, invocation, and compatibility with generic grains.

classes.name: ProviderTests
classes.description: Test suite for Orleans grain providers and extensions, incorporating nested Fixture and Configurator classes for setting up test cluster configurations.

classes.name: ProviderTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up the Orleans test environment, including configuring the test cluster.

classes.name: ProviderTests.Fixture.Configurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add grain extensions for testing.

methods.name: ProviderTests
methods.description: Constructor for the test class, injecting the fixture.

methods.name: Providers_TestExtensions
methods.description: Tests dynamic installation and invocation of grain extensions, including exception handling for uninstalled extensions.

methods.name: Providers_ActivateNonGenericExtensionOfGenericInterface
methods.description: Verifies that a generic grain can activate a non-generic extension without exceptions.

methods.name: Providers_ReferenceNonGenericExtensionOfGenericInterface
methods.description: Verifies that after a generic grain activates, its non-generic extension can be referenced and invoked.

methods.name: Providers_AutoInstallExtensionTest
methods.description: Tests automatic extension installation via configuration, ensuring unconfigured extensions throw exceptions and configured ones are available.
